title: "ROS reference data"
output: html_document
---

The six LL and PS models declare 58 distinct code-list IDs across versions 3.3.0, 4.0.0 and 4.1.0.

Each model also declares the registries used to check officers, observers,
vessels and contacts. Registry matching policies belong to the affected fields;
the registry data remains separate from the models.

This inventory compares the model declarations with the IOTC dissemination view mapping and the
[ROS code-list catalogue](https://ros.ultreia.io/references/code_lists/codelists.csv)
published on 26 October 2026.

All 58 code-list IDs have exact catalogue entries. 8 IDs have an associated database view.
A dash in the view column means no view is declared in the dissemination mapping.

For 4.0.0 LL, `sample_collected_type` uses `refs_biology.biological_materials`.
The workbook header still links to `sampleTypes`; the model follows the agreed
code-list mapping.

For 4.0.0 and 4.1.0 PS, `sample_collected_type` and
`sample_collected_preservation_method` use `refs_biology.biological_materials`
and `refs_biology.sample_preservation_methods`, respectively. Their workbook
headers link to sampling methods and fish storage types instead.

All three LL models use `refs_biology.species_predators` for observed predators.
For hook types, 4.0.0 LL uses `refs_fishery.hook_types` in both hook fields,
while 4.1.0 LL uses `refs_fishery.hook_and_terminal_devices` in `E-SET-HOOKS`
and `refs_fishery.hook_types` in the specimen SSI sheet.

## Code-list aliases

The `IOTC_Ros_4_0_0` database supplies 143 usable `code_orig` mappings for 23
code lists. Another 21 text aliases for `refs_data.logical_responses` map common
true, false and unknown spellings to `TRUE`, `FALSE` and `UNK`. Numeric values
are not aliases. All mappings are shared by the model versions using each list.
They leave submitted values and the published CSV files unchanged.
The complete mapping is bundled in `ros.form.validation/inst/code-list-aliases.csv`.

| Code list                                                |           Aliases |
|----------------------------------------------------------|------------------:|

## Registries declared by the models

All six models use the four registry tables below. Their snapshots are listed in the
[private ROS registry catalogue](https://ros.ultreia.io/references/registries/registries.csv).
Access requires the separate registry account.

| Registry table         | Checked columns                                                                                         | Catalogue CSV              |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `ros_meta.contact`     | `full_name`                                                                                             | `ros_meta.contact.csv`     |
| `ros_meta.focal_point` | `email`, `full_name`                                                                                    | `ros_meta.focal_point.csv` |
| `ros_meta.observer`    | `full_name`, `iotc_observer_identifier`                                                                 | `ros_meta.observer.csv`    |
| `ros_meta.vessel`      | `imo_identifier`, `iotc_vessel_identifier`, `ircs_identifier`, `registration_identifier`, `vessel_name` | `ros_meta.vessel.csv`      |

Registry aliases belong to the validation reference data, not to individual
form models. The shared `ros.form.validation/inst/registry-aliases.csv` contains:

| Registry               | Column        | Submitted alias | Registry value |
| ---------------------- | ------------- | --------------- | -------------- |
| `ros_meta.focal_point` | `full_name`   | Chia Chun WU    | WU JIA CHUN    |
| `ros_meta.focal_point` | `full_name`   | Chia-Chun WU    | WU JIA CHUN    |
| `ros_meta.vessel`      | `vessel_name` | CLIPPERTON      | LE CLIPPERTON  |
| `ros_meta.vessel`      | `vessel_name` | MARIUS 3        | LE MARIUS 3    |

The catalogue also contains `ros_meta.observer_identifier_mapping`; no form model declares it.
